  "The guideline corpus contains recommendations for melanoma (MEL).",
  "The recommendation aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line states that surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "The same recommendation states that surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "The recommendation aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-slnb-timing states that sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "The same recommendation states that sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "The recommendation eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1 states that when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "The same recommendation states that incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The recommendation eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1 has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21)."
